g.text: international three-letter language codes, e.g. pes = Iranian Persian, ckb = Sorani
one ISO code that covers several individual codes, e.g. fas covers pes and prs
neutral word for a language or dialect; avoids deciding which one it is
large multilingual web-text corpus; a proxy for how much text a language has online
community dictionary · database of inflected word forms (paradigms)
language identification: which language is this text? Needed to build corpora
the same sentences in two languages; the raw material of machine translation
standard translation benchmark, about 2K sentences per language
translating through a third language (here Persian or English)
zero-width non-joiner: an invisible character that splits Persian compound words
Persian ritual politeness (e.g. refusing an offer before accepting it)
